en.summary: The patch fixes an L1 MSHR handshake bug by clearing a subentry only when the miss response can actually enqueue downstream.
why_it_counts: The old logic cleared subentry_valid on io.missRspIn.valid alone.
The new logic additionally requires missRspOut_st1.io.enq.ready.
This prevents losing miss-response bookkeeping when the output queue is full.
evidence: Single-line change in ventus/src/L1Cache/L1MSHR.scala gates subentry clearing with missRspOut_st1.io.enq.ready.
The subject explicitly says mshr missrspout queue full fixed.
The touched file is the L1 cache MSHR implementation.

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: MSHR subentry_valid clear condition on miss response
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: Remove the extra ready check from the elsewhen that clears subentry_valid when io.missRspIn.valid is asserted.
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A miss completion is dropped logically before it is queued, causing lost or mismatched cache-miss completions.
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: An MSHR must not retire a tracked miss subentry until the completion message has been accepted by the next stage. Clearing it on incoming valid alone forgets the miss before the response is safely queued.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A miss response arrives while the downstream completion queue is full or not ready.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Clear the tracked subentry on source valid alone.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop ready term from response-retire predicate
portability_notes: Apply to any miss tracker that stages completions through a queue.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that clears an outstanding subentry on response arrival.
Stress the design with a full completion queue.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: subentry_valid clear condition for missRspIn to missRspOut transfer
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds missRspOut_st1.io.enq.ready to the subentry clear condition.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: At the elsewhen that clears subentry_valid for entryMatchMissRsp/subentry_next2cancel, remove missRspOut_st1.io.enq.ready.

evidence_for_injection: The queue below the changed line is depth 1, so backpressure is real.
The only behavioral change is the added ready qualification.

zh.summary: 该补丁修复了 L1 MSHR 的握手错误，只有当 miss response 真正能够向下游入队时才清除对应 subentry。
why_it_counts: 旧逻辑只要 io.missRspIn.valid 为真就会清除 subentry_valid。
新逻辑额外要求 missRspOut_st1.io.enq.ready 为真。
这样可以避免在输出队列已满时提前丢失 miss-response 记账状态。
evidence: ventus/src/L1Cache/L1MSHR.scala 的单行修改用 missRspOut_st1.io.enq.ready 对 subentry 清除进行门控。
提交标题明确写着 mshr missrspout queue full fixed。
被修改文件就是 L1 cache 的 MSHR 实现。

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: miss response 返回时的 MSHR subentry_valid 清除条件
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: 在 io.missRspIn.valid 为真时清除 subentry_valid 的 elsewhen 中，去掉新增的 ready 检查。
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: miss 完成会在真正入队前被逻辑上丢弃，导致 cache-miss 完成丢失或错配。
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: MSHR 只有在完成消息被下一阶段真正接收之后，才能退休对应的 miss subentry。如果仅凭输入 valid 就清除该状态，就会在响应被安全入队之前忘掉这个 miss。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: miss 响应到达时，下游完成队列已满或未 ready。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 只凭源端 valid 就清除被跟踪的 subentry。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 从响应退休谓词中删除 ready 项
portability_notes: 可映射到任何通过队列暂存完成消息的 miss 跟踪器。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到响应到达时清除 outstanding subentry 的逻辑。
删除对下游 ready 的要求。
在完成队列已满时触发该路径。
